task_summary: The customer reports that the Crystal Wine Decanter from order ORD-6023 arrived damaged in transit. The correct handling involves the shipping-damage process: review the shipping and return policy, provide a refund, issue a return label, and include a fragile item goodwill credit only when it applies.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the shipping policy before resolving the damaged-in-transit claim.
Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
Agent must issue the separate $10 fragile-item goodwill credit to original payment.

opening_message: I received the Crystal Wine Decanter from order ORD-6023, but it arrived damaged. The package was crushed.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You purchased the Crystal Wine Decanter as part of order ORD-6023 and it arrived damaged due to crushed packaging.
